issues.issue: Was the SAR's conclusion that applicants retained permanent resident status in Brazil at the relevant time unreasonable?
issues.applicant_position: SAR erred in concluding they had permanent resident status; no info they retained it after two years' absence.
issues.result_text: Status retained at hearing date; SAR's conclusion reasonable.

issues.issue: Did the SAR breach procedural fairness by concluding there was an internal flight alternative in Brasilia without giving applicants an opportunity to present evidence?
issues.applicant_position: SAR failed procedural fairness; applicants had no opportunity to present evidence on internal flight alternative.
issues.result_text: SAR requested submissions; applicants did not seek to submit more evidence.
